scheme_name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (महात्मा फुले जन आरोग्य योजना)
department: Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_amount: ₹5,00,000 / year cashless health cover per family across 1,356 medical procedures & surgeries
submission_desk: Arogyamitra Desk at any Network Hospital / District Civil Hospital

eligibility_rules.label: Resident of Maharashtra
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra.

eligibility_rules.label: Universal Eligibility (Ration Card Holders)
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Holders of Yellow, Orange, or White ration cards (covers almost all non-luxury households).

required_documents.name: Valid Maharashtra Ration Card (Yellow/Orange/White)
required_documents.how_to_get: Issued by Food & Civil Supplies Department (Tehsil Office).

required_documents.name: Photo Identity Proof (Voter ID or Driving License)
required_documents.how_to_get: Standard government voter identification card.

scheme_name: PMAY-G / Ramai Gharkul Rural Housing Scheme (प्रधानमंत्री व रमाई घरकुल योजना)
department: Rural Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_amount: ₹1,38,000 direct grant (₹1.20L construction + ₹18,000 MGNREGA wages + ₹12,000 Swachh Bharat toilet)
submission_desk: Gram Panchayat Office / Gram Sevak / Panchayat Samiti

eligibility_rules.label: Rural Resident of Maharashtra
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Must reside in rural village jurisdiction.

eligibility_rules.label: Low Income / BPL Category
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Family living in kutcha/dilapidated house without pucca roof.

required_documents.name: Gram Sabha House-Site Resolution & Kutcha House Verification
required_documents.how_to_get: Gram Sevak site visit and Gram Sabha register entry.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Account Passbook
required_documents.how_to_get: Bank branch verification for direct DBT transfers.

scheme_name: MahaDBT Krishi Yantrikikaran Subsidy (कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण - ट्रॅक्टर व अवजारे अनुदान)
benefit_amount: 50% to 80% capital subsidy (up to ₹1,25,000 for tractors, ₹25,000-₹50,000 for rotavator/seed drill)
submission_desk: MahaDBT Farmer Portal / Taluka Krishi Adhikari Office

eligibility_rules.label: Maharashtra Resident Farmer
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Farmer must hold cultivable agricultural land in Maharashtra.

eligibility_rules.label: Landholding Eligibility
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Priority preference for Small & Marginal farmers (<= 5 acres get 50% subsidy; SC/ST & women get up to 80%).

eligibility_rules.label: No Duplicate Subsidy in Last 10 Years
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Must not have availed subsidy for the same equipment type in the past 10 years.

required_documents.name: 7/12 and 8-A Extract with applicant name
required_documents.how_to_get: Download from Mahabhumi portal (mahabhumi.gov.in).

required_documents.name: Authorized Dealer Machinery Quotation & GST Invoice
required_documents.how_to_get: Obtain quotation from empanelled vendor.

scheme_name: Magel Tyala Shettale - Farm Pond Subsidy (मागेल त्याला शेततळे योजना)
benefit_amount: Direct subsidy up to ₹75,000 for standard farm pond creation (plastic lining support extra)
submission_desk: Taluka Krishi Adhikari / Gram Sevak / MahaDBT Portal

eligibility_rules.label: Maharashtra Agrarian Landholder
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Farmer must hold cultivable agricultural land.

eligibility_rules.label: Minimum Landholding: 1 Acre
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Applicant must have at least 0.60 hectare (1 acre) of cultivable land.

eligibility_rules.label: No Existing Farm Pond
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Must not have an active government-funded pond on the parcel.

required_documents.name: 7/12 & 8-A Extract showing min 1 acre land
required_documents.how_to_get: Download digitally signed copy from Mahabhumi portal.

scheme_name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana - ₹1 Shetkari Token Scheme (१ रुपयात पीक विमा)
benefit_amount: Up to ₹50,000 / hectare financial risk cover against drought, unseasonal rain. Farmer pays only ₹1.
submission_desk: Common Service Center (CSC) / Krishi Sahayak at Village Panchayat

eligibility_rules.label: Cultivating Land in Maharashtra
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Applies to notified crop areas across all districts of Maharashtra.

eligibility_rules.label: Owner or Tenant/Sharecropper Farmer
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Both land-owning farmers and registered tenant farmers are eligible.

eligibility_rules.label: Notified Kharif/Rabi Crop (Soybean, Cotton, Gram, Onion, Wheat)
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Sowing must be recorded in e-Pik Pahani (ई-पीक पाहणी).

required_documents.name: e-Pik Pahani Mobile Sowing Self-Declaration
required_documents.how_to_get: Register crop via official e-Pik Pahani Android app within 30 days of sowing.

required_documents.name: Updated 7/12 Land Extract
required_documents.how_to_get: Download via Mahabhumi portal or collect from Village Talathi.

scheme_name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (संजय गांधी निराधार अनुदान योजना)
department: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, GoM
category: Social Security Pension for Destitute, Widows & Elderly
benefit_amount: ₹1,500 / month direct pension (₹18,000 / year) to destitute head, widow or disabled person
application_deadline: Ongoing (Quarterly Sanction Committee Meetings by Tehsildar)
submission_desk: Taluka Tehsildar Office (Niradhar Branch) / Nayab Tehsildar Sanjay Gandhi Committee

eligibility_rules.label: Domicile of Maharashtra (15+ years residence)
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Must have resided in Maharashtra continuously for at least 15 years.

eligibility_rules.label: Annual Income Limit: ₹50,000
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹50,000.

eligibility_rules.label: Age 65+ or Destitute Widow/Divyang
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Person aged 65+ without support, OR destitute widow of any age, OR disabled person.

required_documents.name: Tehsildar Certified Income Certificate (< ₹50,000/yr)
required_documents.how_to_get: Apply through Aaple Sarkar Kendra or Talathi enquiry report.

scheme_name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_amount: ₹6,000 / year state addition (Combined ₹12,000 / year with PM-KISAN) in direct bank transfer
submission_desk: Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra / Gram Panchayat Sangram Desk / MahaDBT Portal

eligibility_rules.label: Resident of Maharashtra
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Applicant must reside in Maharashtra and own agricultural land.

eligibility_rules.label: Landholding Farmer
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Must have agricultural land registered in the state revenue records (7/12 extract).

eligibility_rules.label: Small & Marginal Farmer Category
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Landholding should ideally be up to 2 hectares (5 acres).

required_documents.name: Digitally Signed 7/12 & 8A Land Extract
required_documents.how_to_get: Download digitally signed copy from Mahabhumi portal (mahabhumi.gov.in).
prerequisites: Ration Card or Land Survey Number

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook with Aadhaar-NPCI Seeding
required_documents.how_to_get: Visit local bank branch and submit DBT mandate.

scheme_name: Savitribai Phule Scholarship for Rural Girls (सावित्रीबाई फुले शिष्यवृत्ती योजना)
benefit_amount: ₹3,000 / year stipend directly in student bank account + free textbook set
submission_desk: School / College Headmaster office or MahaDBT Scholarship Portal

eligibility_rules.label: Studying in Maharashtra
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Girl student must be studying in a recognized school/college in Maharashtra.

eligibility_rules.label: Female Student Only
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Scheme is specifically for empowering girl students.

eligibility_rules.label: Family Income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Family income must be within lower income bracket.

required_documents.name: College / School Bonafide Certificate
required_documents.how_to_get: Request directly from principal / clerk of current institution.

scheme_name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क शिष्यवृत्ती)
benefit_amount: 50% tuition and exam fee reimbursement directly to college (₹40,000 benefit)
submission_desk: MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarship Portal / College DHE Desk

eligibility_rules.label: Domicile of Maharashtra
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Applicant must be a resident/domicile of Maharashtra.

eligibility_rules.label: Annual Income <= ₹8 Lakhs
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000.

required_documents.name: Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar
required_documents.how_to_get: Aaple Sarkar portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in) or Tahsildar office.

required_documents.name: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate
required_documents.how_to_get: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) or Tahsildar office.

scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students (इतर मागास प्रवर्ग मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती)
department: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Maharashtra
benefit_amount: 100% tuition fee waiver + monthly maintenance allowance (₹25,000 benefit)
submission_desk: MahaDBT Online Portal / District Social Welfare Office

eligibility_rules.label: Domicile of Maharashtra
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Candidate must belong to Maharashtra state.

eligibility_rules.label: OBC Caste Category
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Must hold valid Other Backward Class (OBC) caste certificate.

eligibility_rules.label: Annual Income <= ₹8 Lakhs (Non-Creamy Layer)
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Family income must be within non-creamy layer ceiling.

required_documents.name: OBC Caste Certificate
required_documents.how_to_get: Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) or Tahsil office via Aaple Sarkar.
prerequisites: School Leaving Certificate with Caste entry

required_documents.name: Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate
required_documents.how_to_get: Competent revenue authority (valid for current financial year).

scheme_name: State Minority Higher Education Scholarship (राज्य अल्पसंख्याक शिष्यवृत्ती योजना)
benefit_amount: ₹25,000 / year direct benefit for pursuing higher secondary / technical studies

eligibility_rules.label: Domicile of Maharashtra
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Student must be a resident of Maharashtra.

eligibility_rules.label: Notified Minority Community
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Must belong to notified minority community (Muslim, Buddhist, Christian, Jain, Sikh).

eligibility_rules.label: Family Income <= ₹8 Lakhs
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Total family annual income must not exceed ₹8 Lakhs.

required_documents.name: Self-Declaration of Minority Community / School Leaving Certificate
required_documents.how_to_get: Signed self-declaration on MahaDBT portal or TC showing religion.

scheme_name: Divyang Swadhar & Sahayata Scheme (दिव्यांग स्वाधार व विशेष सहाय्य योजना)
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Maharashtra
benefit_amount: ₹48,000 / year (₹4,000 / month educational stipend & assistive allowance)
submission_desk: District Social Welfare Officer (Divyang Cell) / MahaDBT

eligibility_rules.label: Maharashtra Resident
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Applicant must reside in Maharashtra.

eligibility_rules.label: Person with Benchmark Disability (Divyang 40%+)
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Must possess UDID card or 40%+ benchmark disability certificate.

required_documents.name: UDID (Unique Disability ID) Card or Civil Hospital Certificate
required_documents.how_to_get: Apply online at swavlambancard.gov.in or District Civil Surgeon Medical Board.

scheme_name: Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (अनुसूचित जाती मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती)
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Maharashtra
category: SC Social Justice Higher Education Grant
benefit_amount: 100% compulsory fee waiver + maintenance allowance + book bank (₹35,000 benefit)

eligibility_rules.label: Domicile of Maharashtra
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Applicant must be a resident of Maharashtra.

eligibility_rules.label: Scheduled Caste (SC) Category
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Neo-Buddhist community.

eligibility_rules.label: Family Income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs
eligibility_rules.rule_description: Annual income from all sources must be up to ₹2.5 Lakhs.

required_documents.name: SC Caste Certificate
required_documents.how_to_get: Competent authority via Aaple Sarkar portal.
